query:
SELECT DISTINCT r.id
        FROM restrictions r
        JOIN restriction_occurrences ro ON ro.restriction_id = r.id
        WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND ro.start_time < $2
          AND ro.end_time > $1
          AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR ro.resource_id IS NULL OR ro.resource_id = $3)
        ORDER BY r.id
